title: From 72 minutes to 5: how one environment variable powers two dbt pipelines
description:
How WMCHealth cut a 72-minute dbt pipeline to about 5 minutes with one environment variable.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Maksim Romanchuk and Paul Pedrozo, analytics engineers at WMCHealth, present a dbt design pattern that runs near real-time operational reporting and full historical analytics from the same business logic. One env_var('ENV_NRT') check lets a single model run two modes: active records on a five-minute table build, full history as an overnight incremental. The result is a 93.6% runtime reduction, from 4,340 seconds to 278, and more than 99% less data processed per run.

In this session you'll learn:
• How one environment variable switches a dbt model between two execution modes
• Why inner-join propagation is the cheapest win in the pattern
• How to cut refresh cadence for near real-time reporting

Speakers: Maksim Romanchuk and Paul Pedrozo, analytics engineers, WMCHealth

Learn more about dbt: https://www.getdbt.com/product/what-is-dbt
